  "title": "Test Survey: Employee Satisfaction Survey",
  "description": "A survey to gauge employee satisfaction across different departments.",
  "no_of_participants": 100,
  "gender": "Both",
  "preferred_participants": "Professionals",
  "max_faculty_participants": 10
}

{
  "questions": [
    {
      "questionId": "q_001",
      "questionText": "How satisfied are you with your current role?",
      "questionType": "five_point",
      "required": true,
      "options": [
        "1 - Very Dissatisfied",
        "2 - Dissatisfied",
        "3 - Neutral",
        "4 - Satisfied",
        "5 - Very Satisfied"
      ]
    },
    {
      "questionId": "q_002",
      "questionText": "Which department do you work in?",
      "questionType": "multiple_choice",
      "required": true,
      "options": [
        "Engineering",
        "Sales",
        "Marketing",
        "HR",
        "Operations"
      ]
    },
    {
      "questionId": "q_003",
      "questionText": "What improvements would you like to see in the workplace?",
      "questionType": "fill_in",
      "required": false
    },
    {
      "questionId": "q_004",
      "questionText": "Which benefits are most important to you?",
      "questionType": "multiple_selection",
      "required": true,
      "options": [
        "Health Insurance",
        "Remote Work",
        "Bonus/Equity",
        "Gym Membership"
      ]
    }
  ]
